template.name: Mixed ecosystem
template.description: Many producers support a few foragers, mixotrophs, and predators. Survival depends on the food chain.

environment.name: Sunlit pond
environment.description: Light and minerals support producers; organic food comes from living cells and their remains.

populations.name: Phototroph
populations.description: Autotroph. Turn light and dissolved minerals into growth; release organic food for consumers.

populations.name: Forager
populations.description: Heterotroph. Digest organic food, avoid attackers, and grow before dividing.

populations.name: Mixotroph
populations.description: Mixotroph. Combine light harvesting with organic feeding, trading specialist capacity for flexibility.

populations.name: Predator
populations.description: Heterotroph. Split a finite body between attacking and digesting; hunt only when hungry.

lineageDefinition: Descendants of each starting registered program; mutations may change their diet or body allocation.
bodyRoleDefinition: Current photosynthetic and digestive tissue fractions >=0.05; attackCapable is a separate >=0.05 tissue count.
diagnosticConsumerDefinition: Forager and Predator program descendants, independently of current body role.
